chunks: He was condemned by God and who said: "I shall take from Thy creatures my determinate share."
ai.seo_question: What did Iblis say after being cursed by God regarding his share of humanity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this declaration by Iblis highlights the strategic nature of his enmity, framing human history as a cosmic battlefield where he seeks a 'predetermined share' (nasīb) of the faithful through subtle misguidance. This verse underscores the reality of fitrah (innate disposition) being tested against shaitanic whispers, a theme central to understanding human free will and spiritual struggle (jihad al-nafs).
